user_problem: Cache requirements state keys and mutations but lack concrete invalidation scenarios and stale-read boundaries.
unique_output: A scenario table connecting mutations, affected keys, invalidation timing, readers, and explicitly tolerated staleness.
required_input: Cache key patterns, read paths, mutation events, invalidation rules, and stated staleness allowances.
critical_rule: Do not infer hidden dependencies; identify missing key-to-entity relationships as specification gaps.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is runbook-scenario-table; this designs cache-behavior cases rather than matching incidents to procedures.
acceptance_scenario: Input key product:{id}, list key category:{id}, product update invalidates only product key, tolerance zero. Output shows the product key invalidation and flags category list freshness as unresolved because no relationship rule was supplied.
